GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat back 7l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. A short distance after the start was crowded when taken in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide early 3 lengths. got over to fence 1600 metres. 3rd turn 2 lengths. ran on strongly late # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover until passing the 100m on the first occasion when able to obtain a position on the running rail.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, battled on strong to the line # no match 1,2

Jumped only fairly then taken across to settle midfield 4 Lengths 3 Wide , eased back to joint last at 1500m and on fence at the 1400m, improved marginally to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked widest and improved only a touch in Straight # Wide early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced wide, without cover, in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced 4th Two Wide (7L from lead). Held Ground until tracking up Two Wide from 800m & 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed out Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid out from 300m until 10W @ 150m. Made late ground. # Last 200m OK.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 200m shifted out when placed under pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 3rd last Two Wide 10 Lengths 1000m, went back inside Straightening Up , was only one paced early in Straight but did get going last 100m and Made Good Ground to be Just out of placings # best work late

Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & pushed to chase 3 Wide @ 650m. Pushed along Four Wide @ 550m & chasing 9W (8L from lead) on home turn. Ground home steadily in straight. # Fair effort.

Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (6L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken @ 700m. Chasing on inside @ 600m & pressured Two Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Ground home @ one pace in straight. # Never Likely

Away OK. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Tacked on to bunch midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 550m. Chasing Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & ran on soundly in last 200m. # Gave too much start

Began OK. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (6L from lead). Improved 2 Lengths midrace & 3 Wide @ 600m. Tracking winner fwd from 550m & pushed to quicken Six Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & chased steadily in last 200m. # OK from rear.
Jumped Ok immed Restrained last 12 Lengths Couldn'T Get Close ..vet-clear # awful
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported the gelding failed to travel throughout.  A post-race veterinary examination did not reveal any significant findings.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. last mid race. moved up 4th turn 3 lengths. just battled in Straight # fitter now
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted in and bumped runner.
